name: data_quality
description: Representative offline integration example, not headline eval data. Data-quality flag from real kit event act-A0030 (training mission M003): a gauge reading of Compressor 14 that failed with SENSOR_TIMEOUT and left a QUESTIONABLE pressure value at 17% battery. Demonstrates meta.path fallback with the templated explanation (meta.model template). All numbers computed from amd/system1/data/kit with triage.policy 2026-10-10.1. Database flag ID is illustrative; MCP IDs retained;

flag.title: What should the operator do about flag flag:act-A0030?

reasons.detail: Battery 17% is at or below the 25% low threshold

facts.fact: A SENSOR_TIMEOUT failure gives data_quality, and battery 17% at or below the 25% low threshold gives P2, under policy 2026-10-10.1.
Quality QUESTIONABLE makes the reading untrusted, so it is not compared to the PRESSURE_PSI safe band 76.0-140.0.

allowed_actions.REINSPECT_NOW: send SPOT back to repeat the inspection now
allowed_actions.MANUAL_READING: have a technician take the reading by hand
allowed_actions.CHECK_SENSOR_PAYLOAD: inspect SPOT's sensor payload / camera for faults
allowed_actions.REINSPECT_NEXT_ROUTE: repeat the inspection on the next route
